description: Read who is credited as author on the brand's side pages, per kind: `comparison` (comparison pages) and `feature` (feature/spotlight and other long-form side pages). Each value is a BlogAuthor id, "none" (no author; the brand is credited), or null (follow the blog default author, see set_default_blog_author). A page can override its kind's default via edit_side_page authorId/hideAuthor.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

name: get_side_page_author_defaults
